title: A full life alone
hookLine: a single person's Jewish life is whole, not waiting
tomorrow: a sage says acquire a friend. can you actually buy one?

cards: Every wedding season, someone leans across the table to the one single guest and asks: so, anyone special? Here's a puzzle in the Torah.

The first time God calls anything not good, it's this, in Genesis: "It is not good that the man should be alone." And yet the Talmud keeps quoting, with honor, a sage who never married. How do those two fit?

teach.h: BEN AZZAI: MY SOUL LONGS FOR TORAH.
teach.b: The sage is Ben Azzai. In the Talmud he's asked why he never married, and he answers: my soul longs for Torah; the world can be kept going by others. The rabbis argue with him.
They don't erase him. His sayings sit in Pirkei Avot, among them: run to do even a small mitzvah, because one good deed brings another. So read Genesis again.
The problem it names is being alone: cut off, no one alongside.

teach.h: ALONE MEANS CUT OFF, NOT SINGLE.
teach.b: A person can be single and not alone in that sense, with friends, a table, a community, work worth doing. The prophet Isaiah speaks to people who had no children and feared they'd be forgotten.

teach.h: A NAME BETTER THAN SONS AND DAUGHTERS.
teach.b: God promises them "a monument and a memorial better than sons and daughters." A name that isn't cut off. And notice how Jewish life is built.

teach.h: SHABBAT DOESN'T WAIT FOR A WEDDING.
teach.b: Shabbat starts at sundown whether there's one at the table or ten. The candles light the same.
A mezuzah blesses a studio apartment as fully as a family house. None of it is waiting for a wedding. Something to tell a friend tonight: in Genesis, what's not good is being alone, not being single.

how: Single Jews keep Shabbat, holidays and a mezuzah on the door like anyone else; communities host Shabbat meals and study groups, and some single adults host their own Shabbat tables.

games.q: what does “a full life alone” mean?
o: a single life that is whole, not on hold
a vow to live apart from other people
a time of mourning after a partner dies

games.q: single, not alone — tap the pairs.
p: a name better than sons and daughters

s: Genesis says being single is not good
it says being alone isn't good: the problem is being cut off.
the Talmud quotes Ben Azzai, who never married, with honor
his sayings sit in Pirkei Avot.
Jewish practice is mostly on hold until you marry
Shabbat, candles and a mezuzah are the same for one person or ten.

games.q: a friend just moved to a new city, single, and says she'll start hosting Shabbat dinners 'once she's married.' what fits today's lesson?
o: start now; Shabbat and a table don't wait for a wedding.
wait; Shabbat dinner is really meant for families with kids.
skip Shabbat until she finds a community to join.
games.why: Shabbat starts at sundown for one or for ten, and a table with friends answers Genesis' 'alone'.

practice: Close your eyes if that's comfortable, and sit as you are, in the room you're in. Notice what already fills your life: a person, a place, a piece of work, a habit you love.
For these two minutes, let nothing be missing and nothing be waiting.

wordCard.voice: A full life alone: single isn't the same as alone. Ben Azzai's life and Isaiah's lasting name both count as whole.

carryVoice: Keep it handy: whole as you are, at any table, with any number of chairs. Ten of fifteen.
